# ADR Template

Copy this template to `docs/decisions/ADR-<id>-<short-name>.md`.

Before filling this template, read `docs/standards/QUALITY_BAR.md#good-adr`.

## Copy And Fill Rules

- AI may draft ADRs, but Human owns final acceptance.
- Replace `ADR-000` with `ADR-<id>-<short-name>`.
- Use ADRs for durable decisions, not temporary implementation notes.
- Link triggering tickets/bugs and master docs.
- If a decision supersedes another ADR, link the old ADR and set its status to `superseded`.

## Field Ownership

- Human owns decision approval and final ADR status.
- AI may draft context, decision text, alternatives, consequences, and links for review.
